verdict.rationale: The Global Catalog MCP server lets agents search products across the whole Shopify ecosystem, with results clustered by UPID and offers from multiple merchants. Access uses a self-declared agent profile, with Anonymous and Signed tiers and self-serve Dev Dashboard credentials, so no partnership is needed. Runtime probes confirm a keyless handshake, and the UCP CLI with a self-generated local profile searched the live catalog; the invalid_profile_url error on a profile-less call matches the documented identity requirement rather than contradicting it. Missing for 10: raw keyless search still needs a hosted agent profile and anonymous traffic gets the lowest rate limits, and the probe does not clearly show a cross-merchant Global Catalog search returning results end to end.
